title: Under the Cold Stars

scene_summit.narration: Above the Frostfang Peaks the stars are close enough to count. They make a pattern that matches the cracks in the glacier below.

scene_pattern.narration: You learn the shape of the stars by heart. The blue door in the ice has the same shape.
